description:
The user approved step C, a per-process continuation region, relayed by Callables on 2026-11-19. This answers decision 72 (3). Design page: https://claude.ai/artifact/DLaBcsPBUr1LwXpc4rhAvX. Owner: Callables.

Spike, E0 + E1.

## E0
Count how often release_resumed_frame gives a frame back today, on the JSON workloads and the distiller. Prediction: under 30% on docs decode.

## E1
Run a region spike with two debug traps over every fixture on run and build, and on the distiller. One trap fires when a region address is stored into a heap object; the other when a resumed frame is not the newest.

## Output
A list of every holder found, with its fix. Nothing lands except the traps, and only if they earn their place.
title: Every continuation is resumed newest-first, and no heap object holds one
